data.title: C005: baseline partial-order reduction engine (stateful persistent + sleep sets) with reduction witness checker and exhaustive differential corpus

data.body:
[MEDIUM][CWE-400/CWE-770] Charge checker label construction before allocating it

checker.rs:280-301 walks every outcome and pushes to three vectors, but only expression nodes decrement the work counter. A valid action can have arbitrarily many empty outcomes (crates/continuum-model-core/src/model.rs:647-659 and 818-859). With one constant guard and work=1, Checker::new spends the guard unit, then performs O(outcomes) iteration and allocation. run charges width only after initialization at checker.rs:474-475. WorkExhausted therefore arrives after the declared budget boundary was bypassed. This can exhaust CPU or memory on an untrusted model. Charge each outcome before any per-outcome work or allocation. Add an exact-boundary regression for high-fanout empty outcomes.

Failure modes: CPU latency and memory exhaustion occur before typed WorkExhausted.
Edge cases: One constant guard plus empty outcomes maximizes the bypass. Low work and large label width make it deterministic.
Rollback: Keep C005 unpromoted, or remove this checker surface, until charge-before-work is restored.
Monitoring: Record label count, checker work limit, elapsed time, and peak RSS. Alert when WorkExhausted follows disproportionate initialization.
Validation: Sweep exact work boundaries across increasing outcome counts. Prove failure occurs before proportional allocation, and retain a large bounded regression.

data.body:
[MEDIUM][CWE-400/CWE-770] Start the work meter before obligation-proportional work

`run` validates every obligation and collects all indices before it creates `Meter`. Predicate count is not capped in `continuum-model-core/src/model.rs:881-905`. With many constant predicates and `work = 0`, this path performs O(predicates) traversal and allocation. If footprint derivation then refuses, `refused` at engine.rs:195-217 walks and allocates one result per invariant without a charge.

Failure modes: CPU and memory use occur outside the declared work bound before typed `Bound::Work`.
Edge cases: `Obligations::every_predicate` over many constant predicates with zero work maximizes the bypass.
Rollback: Keep C005 unpromoted until all obligation-proportional work is metered.
Monitoring: Record predicate count, work limit, elapsed time, and peak RSS.
Validation: Add an exact-boundary large-predicate regression that refuses before proportional traversal or allocation.

[MEDIUM][CWE-400/CWE-770] Charge the state-index lookup before performing it

`enter` calls `self.index.get(&state)` at line 666 before any search charge. A miss is charged later inside `create_node`, after the lookup already ran. A hit never receives a state-index charge. Cyclic models can therefore perform repeated BTreeMap searches proportional to state arity and log(stored states) while `stats.work` accounts only for label evaluation and later visit work.

Failure modes: CPU exceeds the declared work budget without a timely `Bound::Work`.
Edge cases: Many transitions back into a large existing state index maximize unpaid comparisons.
Rollback: Keep C005 unpromoted until every index lookup is prepaid.
Monitoring: Compare transition count and stored-state count against work and elapsed time.
Validation: Add exact-boundary cyclic tests whose required work grows with index depth and state arity.

[MEDIUM][CWE-400/CWE-770] Charge proviso collection before allocation

At line 887, `extra.to_vec()` scans set bits and allocates a vector proportional to the extra-label count. Line 888 charges that count only after the work completed. The earlier word charges cover bitset operations, not the set-bit iteration and vector allocation.

Failure modes: A low remaining work budget allocates and fills the proviso expansion before returning `Bound::Work`.
Edge cases: A wide reduced state whose back edge adds most enabled labels maximizes the bypass.
Rollback: Keep C005 unpromoted until the cardinality charge precedes collection.
Monitoring: Record proviso extra-label count, remaining work, elapsed time, and peak RSS.
Validation: Add an exact-boundary wide-proviso regression that fails before `to_vec` when one unit short.

[MEDIUM][CWE-400/CWE-770] Meter the remaining checker collections before work

`stubborn_sets` reserves `count` entries and pushes once per node without a preceding count charge. Full expansions take the uncharged arm at line 707. Separately, checker.rs:800-812 charges each visit edge only linearly, but checker.rs:869-870 inserts every donated label into a growing `BTreeSet`; distinct donations perform O(E log E) comparisons before any matching logarithmic charge. The later coverage charge cannot make either operation charge-before-work.

Failure modes: Checker CPU or memory exceeds `work` before typed `WorkExhausted`.
Edge cases: Many full nodes trigger the first gap. Many distinct donated edges with empty child sleep sets trigger the second.
Rollback: Keep C005 unpromoted until both collections are prepaid.
Monitoring: Record node count, donated-edge count, checker work, elapsed time, and peak RSS.
Validation: Extend exact-boundary tests with all-full witnesses and growing distinct donations, including counted touches for both stages.

[MEDIUM][CWE-693] Do not claim terminal-state agreement for the terminal-allowed scope without comparing it

`reference::DeadlockOutcome::NotJudged` exposes no states, and this comparator only populates `reduced_deadlocks` from `Deadlocked`. Under the narrow scope, both sets are therefore empty by policy. The checker comparison at lines 425-427 also skips deadlocks when `scope.defect` is false. Yet the retained ledger says terminal states agree under both scopes. A narrow-observer reduction can lose a terminal state whose visible projection duplicates another state and still report agreement.

Failure modes: Evidence reports a false green and promotes C005 without testing one stated preservation result.
Edge cases: Terminal and live states with one visible projection expose the blind spot.
Rollback: Keep the claim scoped to the comparisons actually made, or keep C005 unpromoted.
Monitoring: Report wide and narrow terminal counts and identity mismatches separately.
Validation: Compare terminal-state sets from the raw oracle exploration and the checker for both policies, then add a narrow-observer negative control.

[MEDIUM][CWE-693] Faulted corpus rows do not validate the stated preservation surface

On any reference evaluation error, `oracle_of` discards all states, projections, transitions, and terminal states. Then lines 319-335 return after checking only that some reduced fault reproduces. The 44 faulted rows therefore establish fault existence, not preservation of every reachable evaluation fault, visible valuation, or deadlock as stated in RFC 0004 and `tools/governance/reviews/bn-voq4.toml:61-63`. They also cannot support like-for-like state totals because oracle states become zero while partial reducer states remain counted.

Failure modes: A reducer can miss other faults or reachable results and the corpus still reports agreement.
Edge cases: Models with multiple reachable faults, or one fault after distinct visible and terminal states, maximize the gap.
Rollback: Limit the claim to fault-existence agreement, or keep C005 unpromoted.
Monitoring: Record fault identity, partial reachable states, projections, and terminal sets on both engines.
Validation: Use an oracle mode that retains the explored prefix and exact fault set, plus a multi-fault negative control.

data.body:
[MEDIUM][CWE-400/CWE-770] Meter projection finalization before allocating and ordering it

engine.rs:1275-1288 projects every stored state and inserts each vector into a growing BTreeSet after search metering has ended. The node charge at lines 662-670 pays one logarithmic search and names it as the state-index insert. It cannot also pay this later ordered insert under the per-site credit discipline. The independent checker confirms the missing cost model at checker.rs:1222-1228, where it prepays count * state width * log(count) before building the same projection set. A Work-exhausted or state-bounded run can therefore allocate and compare O(states * visible-width * log states) after the last fallible charge, while stats.work and c005_bnd_05 still claim that no work occurs unpaid.

Failure modes: A large untrusted model consumes CPU and memory beyond Bounds::work while returning a normally typed report.
Edge cases: Many stored states with distinct, wide visible projections maximize both vector allocation and ordered comparisons. Exhaustion just before finish makes the bypass exact.
Rollback: Keep C005 unpromoted, or omit projection materialization, until finalization is prepaid.
Monitoring: Record stored states, visible width, projection count, finalization time, peak RSS, and the work limit.
Validation: Add an exact-boundary regression with many distinct wide projections. One unit below the projection-finalization charge must return Bound::Work before any projection vector or set entry is created.

data.reason: One open MEDIUM finding: report projection finalization performs O(states * visible-width * log states) allocation and ordering after the last fallible work charge, so an untrusted model can exceed Bounds::work.

data.body: [RESOLVED] Target f42de595 fixes this path. engine.rs:265-284 calls pay_finalization before finish and returns typed work exhaustion without witness nodes or projections on refusal. engine.rs:1129-1157 prepays node records, projection construction and ordered inserts, visit and edge records, terminal collection and sorting, statistics passes, and the label table from counts only. mutation.rs:424-472 tests the exact one-unit-short boundary across three models.

[RISK-HIGH REVIEW]

Failure modes: Unsound reduction could hide a violation, deadlock, undefined read, or evaluation fault. Unpaid work could exceed the declared bound. checker.rs:671-1371 independently rejects incomplete labels, footprints, transitions, stubborn closure, visibility, sleep sets, coverage, and reduced cycles. engine.rs:265-284 rejects unpaid finalization.

Edge cases: Cycles, repeated states with different sleep sets, high fan-out, wide states, exact work limits, nested definedness, faults, and terminal-allowed runs received focused inspection.

Rollback: Keep C005 unpromoted and remove its consumer path. This range does not establish production promotion authority.

Monitoring: Track work, states, visits, transitions, reduction counts, checker defects, differential disagreements, mutation survival, and any new production consumer.

Validation: Persisted differential and mutation evidence covers declared C005 claims. mutation.rs:424-472 covers finalization refusal. Static review does not replace fresh gate execution or risk:critical human approval.
